# Arkadii Quest / Аркадия Квест

> Arkadii Quest is a free old-school multiplayer 3D browser RPG set in Arkadia.

Players explore shared environments, fight creatures, complete quests, collect
and equip loot, improve their heroes, trade with characters, and use global
chat. The game runs directly in a WebGL-capable browser and does not require an
installation. Its active interface and game content support English and
Russian.

## Canonical pages

- Play: https://arkadii.world/game/
- Technical documentation: https://arkadii.world/game/docs/
- Localization, onboarding, and controls: https://arkadii.world/game/docs/#localization_and_controls
- API and security reference: https://arkadii.world/game/docs/#api_and_security
- Game quality audit: https://arkadii.world/game/docs/#game_quality_audit

## Controls and onboarding

The first entry into the world presents a localized three-step onboarding path
and an essential control table. Desktop players can reopen it with F1; touch
players use the persistent guide button.

Keyboard play supports WASD or arrow-key movement, hotbar keys 1-9, E for
interaction, Tab for the nearest target, Enter for chat, and panel hotkeys.
Touch play uses a virtual joystick, a tappable hotbar, and contextual target,
interaction, and chat buttons.

The gameplay camera keeps a fixed isometric angle, follows the active hero,
looks ahead while moving, and adjusts distance automatically. Mouse-wheel zoom,
mouse-drag rotation, and touch-swipe rotation are not camera controls.

## Technology

The browser client uses Babylon.js and TypeScript. Multiplayer rooms use
Colyseus over WebSockets, with an Express API and SQL persistence. The web shell
includes an accessible preference/login flow, responsive portrait and landscape
layouts, actionable loading failures, and bilingual `VideoGame` structured
metadata.
